theater: 西沙群島永樂群島甘泉島外海

battle.name: 西沙之戰
battle.theater: 西沙群島永樂群島甘泉島外海
battle.brief: 西沙海戰爆發於一九七四年一月十九日至二十日的西沙永樂群島。中國海軍四艘獵潛與掃雷艦對上南越海軍四艘美製軍艦，越方先開火，日早號當日沉沒；二十日中方攻佔甘泉、珊瑚、金銀三島。卡面加特林機槍的旋轉多管連射，是這場戰役雙方近程火力所欠、而日後密集陣一類武器所承續的源頭。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 這是一場兩個執政體在同一片島礁上直接交手的短促海戰。中方是中華人民共和國海軍南海艦隊，實際作戰指揮落在駐海南崖縣的榆林海軍基地：一月十四日南海艦隊令基地組織自一九五九年三月以來的第七十七次西沙巡邏；十六日中央軍委決定全體行動統一由廣州軍區（司令員許世友）指揮，並在榆林基地成立作戰指揮班子。十九日凌晨周恩來以電話指示葉劍英召集六人小組研究作戰方案，葉劍英、鄧小平、陳錫聯、張春橋、王洪文、蘇振華當日清晨在作戰指揮室聽取匯報、定下兵力調配，海上編隊則由基地副司令員兼參謀長魏鳴森任「海指」指揮員，指揮四艘直接參戰的獵潛與掃雷艦。陸戰力量為守備第一百五十團與要塞區直屬兩棲偵察隊組成的加強營，另西南中沙人武部四個排武裝民兵進駐晉卿、琛航等島。越方是越南共和國海軍，越戰末期靠美軍移交的艦艇重建了西沙特遣隊：HQ-5「陳平仲」旗艦、HQ-16「李常傑」、HQ-4「陳慶餘」、HQ-10「日早」四艘美製軍艦，另有海軍突擊連與多支突擊隊、地方陸軍一個排駐守黃沙島，島上還有美軍顧問。越方最高決策者是總統阮文俢，十八日晚以電報授權登陸琛航島並授權還擊開火。
countriesEn: This was a short, sharp naval clash in which two rival governments fought it out over the same chain of reefs. On the Chinese side stood the South Sea Fleet of the People's Liberation Army Navy, whose operational command actually sat at the Yulin naval base in Qiongzhong County, Hainan: on 14 January the fleet ordered the base to conduct the seventy-seventh Xisha patrol since March 1959, and on 16 January the Central Military Commission decided that all operations would be unified under the Guangzhou Military Region under commander Xu Shiyou, with a battle command group formed at Yulin. In the small hours of 19 January Zhou Enlai telephoned Ye Jianying to convene a six-man group to study the plan; Ye Jianying, Deng Xiaoping, Chen Xilian, Zhang Chunqiao, Wang Hongwen and Su Zhenhua gathered before dawn in the operations room, took the briefings and settled the disposition of forces. At sea, Wei Mingsen, deputy commander and chief of staff of the Yulin base, commanded the so-called Sea Command over the four submarines and minesweepers that fought directly. The landing force was an reinforced battalion built from the 150th Garrison Regiment and the base's amphibious reconnaissance company, with four platoons of armed militia from the Southwest Zhongsha People's Armed Department taking positions on Jinqing, Chenhang and neighbouring islets. On the other side was the Navy of the Republic of Vietnam, whose Paracel detachment had been rebuilt with the warships handed over by the withdrawing Americans at the end of the Vietnam War: the frigate HQ-5 Trần Bình Trọng as flagship, HQ-16 Ly Thường Kiệt, HQ-4 Trần Khánh Dư and HQ-10 Nhật Tảo, together with a naval assault company, several assault teams and a local army platoon holding the island the Vietnamese called Hoang Sa, with a United States military adviser also on the island. The highest decision was taken by President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu, who on the evening of 18 January cabled the flagship authorising the landing on Chenhang Island and authorising return fire.
people: 中國方面的決策鏈條極短。十九日凌晨周恩來電話指示葉劍英「立即組織領導小組，由你負責，到總參謀部指揮作戰」，並提出小組名單，鄧小平、陳錫聯、張春橋、王洪文、蘇振華參與；葉劍英第一個到達作戰指揮室，聽取情報、調配艦艇、連續下令。前方由海軍榆林基地副司令員兼參謀長魏鳴森任海上指揮，乘 271 艇「錦州」坐鎮；獵潛第七十三大隊大隊長王克強在十六日的緊急會議上主動請纓，第七十四大隊 281 艇艇長李錦林、282 艇艇長謝春林分別帶隊。陸戰由海南軍區司令員江雪山組成西沙基指，副司令員江海任西沙前指，十九日傍晚率參戰艦艇出航，二十日登島前登上 271 艇與魏鳴森合流指揮。基層的表現同樣被記錄：274 艇政委馮松柏、副艇長周錫通在指揮台被四十毫米砲彈片擊中陣亡，389 艦水雷兵郭玉東以身體堵住被轟開的後艙漏洞，死後仍保持堵漏姿態，被追授一等功並譽為「海上黃繼光」；登島的四連連長梁進理、黎族戰士呂亞仁，珊瑚島五連連長符之頡、兩棲偵察隊副指導員鄒妃豪與班長鍾振國均有戰功。越方與美方的人員同樣有名有姓：HQ-16 艦長黎文實中校在戰後自述艦體重創經過，HQ-10 艦長魏文他重傷陣亡、隨艦沉沒，一名美軍中校范文鴻在珊瑚島被俘，南越總統阮文俢的授權電報是整場衝突的開關。
peopleEn: The Chinese chain of decision was extraordinarily short. In the small hours of 19 January Zhou Enlai telephoned Ye Jianying with the instruction to organize a leading group immediately and take charge of operations at the General Staff Headquarters, and he named the members himself; Deng Xiaoping, Chen Xilian, Zhang Chunqiao, Wang Hongwen and Su Zhenhua took part. Ye Jianying was the first to arrive in the operations room, where the group took the intelligence briefings, allocated the ships and issued a stream of orders to the front. At sea, Wei Mingsen, deputy commander and chief of staff of the Yulin naval base, commanded from the 271 boat Jinzhou; Wang Keqiang, commander of the 73rd submarine brigade, volunteered on 16 January at the emergency meeting to sail at once, while the 74th brigade under boat captains Li Jinlin and Xie Chunlin dispatched the 281 and 282 boats. On the land side, Jiang Xueshan, commander of the Hainan Military Region, set up the Xisha base command, and his deputy Jiang Hai took the forward command, sailing with the task force on the evening of 19 January and joining Wei Mingsen aboard the 271 boat to direct the landings on 20 January. The performance of the men in the ranks is likewise recorded: political commissar Feng Songbai and deputy boat captain Zhou Xitong of the 274 boat were killed when fragments of a 40 mm shell struck the bridge; water-mine sailor Guo Yudong on the 389 sweeper plugged with his own body a hole torn in the aft cabin by a shell hit, still holding the breach when he was found, and was posthumously awarded first-class merit and called the naval Huang Jiguang; boat company commander Liang Jinli and the Li ethnic soldier Lü Yaren of the 4th Company, the 5th Company commander Fu Zhijie and the reconnaissance team deputy instructor Zou Feihao and squad leader Zhong Zhenguo all earned distinction. The Vietnamese and American dead and missing were named as well: the captain of HQ-16, Lieutenant Commander Lê Văn Thự, described afterwards how his ship was gutted; the captain of HQ-10, Ngụy Văn Thà, was mortally wounded and went down with his ship; one United States lieutenant colonel, Phạm Văn Hồng, was captured on Coral Island; and the cable authorising the whole collision was President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu's.
kits: 卡面這件加特林機槍定於一八六〇年，六根砲管由人力轉動，靠管軸旋轉把後坐力分六次吃掉。它在一九七四年一月的西沙海面並沒有出現過，但它正是這場戰役所屬技術品類的源頭：一八六〇年代之後，多管並聯與旋轉供彈的近程機關砲逐步取代單管手動火砲，一九八〇年代服役的密集陣一類近防武器系統把這一原理推到極致。一九七四年的雙方近程火力卻仍停在人工裝填的階段：中方 6604 型獵潛艇裝一門八十五毫米砲與兩門三十七毫米砲，後者每門射速可達三百六十至四百發，但瞄準、裝填全靠人手；6610 型掃雷艦裝兩座雙聯三十七毫米砲與兩座雙聯二十五毫米砲，二十五毫米砲有效射程僅二千七百餘米；037 型獵潛艇裝雙聯五十七毫米砲與雙聯三十毫米砲，另有四座五聯裝火箭深彈發射裝置與兩個深水炸彈投放器。越方火力更強也更自動化：HQ-5 有一門一百二十七毫米砲、十門四十毫米砲與六門二十毫米加農砲，HQ-16 同樣配一百二十七毫米砲，HQ-4 有自動裝彈的七十六毫米砲並以雷達瞄準，HQ-10 配七十六毫米砲與兩座雙聯四十毫米砲。這些單管、單座、靠彈鏈供彈的速射砲，正是加特林原理出現之前、也尚未被加特林原理取代的那一代武器。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on this card dates from 1860: six barrels turned by hand, the barrels revolving on their axis so that the recoil is taken up six times over. It was never present on the waters of the Paracels in January 1974, but it is precisely the ancestor of the class of weapon that decided this battle. After the 1860s, multi-barrel and rotary-fed close-range machine guns gradually displaced single-barrel hand-worked cannon, and the Phalanx-type close-in weapon systems that entered service in the 1980s carried the same principle to its extreme. The near-range firepower of both sides in 1974 was still at the stage of manual loading: the Chinese 6604-type anti-submarine boat carried one 85 mm gun and two 37 mm guns, the latter capable of 360 to 400 rounds a minute each, but aiming and reloading were done entirely by hand; the 6610-type minesweeper carried two twin 37 mm mountings and two twin 25 mm mountings, the 25 mm guns having an effective range of only about 2,778 metres; the 037-type boat carried twin 57 mm and twin 30 mm guns, plus four five-tube rocket depth-charge launchers and two depth-charge rails. The Vietnamese were stronger and far more automatic: HQ-5 mounted one 127 mm gun, ten 40 mm guns and six 20 mm cannon, HQ-16 likewise carried a 127 mm gun, HQ-4 had automatically loading 76 mm guns directed by radar, and HQ-10 carried a 76 mm gun and two twin 40 mm mountings. These single-barrel, single-mount, belt-fed rapid-fire guns belong to the generation that came before the Gatling principle and had not yet been superseded by it.
tactics: 打響之前是長時間的海上對峙與逼近。十八日凌晨 274 艇突然逼近南越 HQ-4 至一鏈、不到半小時逼其退往珊瑚島；同日八時零五分 389 艦與 HQ-16 發生碰撞，九時零四分 HQ-4 後甲板機槍鳴槍兩發，雙方艦隊各自分成南北兩組在中線兩側對峙。十九日上午十時二十分，越方四艦展開戰鬥隊形、相背而行；十時二十三分 HQ-16 先以一百二十七毫米砲射擊 396、389 編隊，中方 396 艦後部三十七毫米雙聯砲隨即還擊，389 艦首發命中 HQ-16 一部主機。271、274 編隊誤把 HQ-4 當成旗艦，集中火力先擊中其雷達，使配備自動裝彈砲的「陳慶餘」難以瞄準開火。十一時許，越方四艦相繼受創撤離，389 艦操縱失靈、十一時五十分搶灘擱淺；十二時十二分趕到的 281、282 艇以雙聯五十七毫米穿甲彈攻擊失去機動力的 HQ-10，十二時三十分命中其彈藥庫爆炸，十四時五十二分沉沒。二十日的登島是另一套打法：九時三十分四艘護衛艇對甘泉島實施艦砲火力準備，九時五十五分四連乘橡皮舟與舢板衝灘，十時十分即占領全島；珊瑚島先由兩艘護衛艇與掃雷艦射擊，部隊在十分鐘內泅渡一千公尺登灘，攻下三層鋼筋混凝土砲樓；金銀島則以班排拉網搜索。整場戰鬥的有效射程極短，中方八十五毫米砲在三公里以外難以精確射擊，只能靠近距離直瞄。
tacticsEn: Before the shooting started there was a long sea stand-off and a series of approaches. In the early hours of 18 January the 274 boat suddenly closed to within one cable of the Vietnamese HQ-4, forcing her towards Coral Island in under half an hour; at 08:05 the same day the 389 sweeper collided with HQ-16, and at 09:04 the machine gun on HQ-4's quarterdeck fired two rounds, after which the two fleets split into northern and southern groups facing each other across the midpoint of the line they claimed. At 10:20 on the morning of 19 January the four Vietnamese ships formed line of battle, the two pairs steaming apart; at 10:23 HQ-16 opened fire with her 127 mm gun on the 396 and 389 group, the aft twin 37 mm mountings of the 396 answering at once, and the 389 scored the first hit, putting one of HQ-16's main engines out of action. The 271 and 274 boats mistook HQ-4 for the flagship and concentrated on her, knocking out her radar first, which left the automatically loading guns of the Trần Khánh Dư unable to aim and fire. By about 11:00 the four Vietnamese ships had taken damage and begun to withdraw; the 389 had lost steering and ran aground at 11:50; and the 281 and 282 boats, which arrived at 12:12, worked over the powerless HQ-10 with twin 57 mm armour-piercing shells, hitting her magazine at 12:30 so that she blew up and sank at 14:52. The landings of 20 January followed a different script: at 09:30 four patrol boats laid down naval gunfire on Cam Tuyet island, at 09:55 the 4th Company went ashore in rubber boats and sampans, and by 10:10 the island was held. On Coral Island the fire preparation was delivered by two patrol boats and a minesweeper, the troops swam the thousand metres from the transport to the beach in about twenty minutes and took a three-storey reinforced concrete gun position; on Money Island the sweep was carried out by platoons and squads. The whole engagement was fought at ranges so short that the Chinese 85 mm guns could not fire accurately beyond three kilometres and had to shoot almost point-blank.
data: 數字要從雙方的紀錄裡分開看。一月二十日一役，中方以四艘直接參戰的獵潛、掃雷艦對上越方同樣四艘軍艦，越方四艦總排水量約七千八百四十噸，中方四艦合計不足兩千噸，差距約為四倍半；HQ-5 與 HQ-16 排水量達二千八百噸，HQ-4 約一千五百噸，HQ-10 僅六百五十噸。中方 6604 型獵潛艇標準排水量三百二十噸、航速十八節，多年服役後已退化到約十二節；6610 型掃雷艦五百七十噸、十五節；037 型三百七十五噸、三十節。火力參數上，八十五毫米砲射速每分鐘十五至十八發，三十七毫米砲每門三百六十至四百發，二十五毫米砲每門八百至九百發，五十七毫米砲加裝水冷後射速可達每分鐘一百二十發。傷亡與戰損：中國軍方陣亡十八人、受傷六十七人；越軍陣亡七十五人、受傷十六人、被俘四十八人（含美軍一人），中方宣稱斃傷敵軍三百餘人、擊沉一艦擊傷三艦。彈痕紀錄可核：HQ-4 戰後有直徑十五厘米以上彈洞三十七個、以下四十二個、彈片擦傷七百餘處；HQ-16 彈痕八百二十處、重傷傾側十五度。登島階段中方投入加強營五百餘人，民兵每排約四十人，珊瑚島守軍三十餘人、甘泉島守軍一個排，二十日共俘南越官兵四十八人。
dataEn: The figures have to be read separately for each side. On 19 January the Chinese put four submarines and minesweepers into the line against four Vietnamese warships of the same number; the four Vietnamese ships totalled some 7,840 tons while the four Chinese boats came to less than 2,000 tons, a gap of roughly four and a half to one. HQ-5 and HQ-16 displaced 2,800 tons, HQ-4 about 1,500 tons and HQ-10 only 650 tons. On the Chinese side the 6604-type boat had a standard displacement of 320 tons and a designed speed of 18 knots, degraded to about 12 knots after years of service; the 6610-type minesweeper was 570 tons at 15 knots, and the 037-type 375 tons at 30 knots. In firepower terms the 85 mm gun fired 15 to 18 rounds a minute, the 37 mm guns 360 to 400 rounds a minute each, the 25 mm guns 800 to 900 rounds a minute each, and the 57 mm gun with water cooling could reach 120 rounds a minute. On losses and damage: the Chinese lost 18 dead and 67 wounded; the Vietnamese counted 75 dead, 16 wounded and 48 captured, one of the prisoners being an American, while the Chinese claimed over 300 of the enemy killed or wounded, one ship sunk and three damaged. The battle damage can be checked: the Trần Khánh Dư was found afterwards with thirty-seven holes larger than fifteen centimetres, forty-two smaller ones and more than seven hundred fragment scars, while the Ly Thường Kiệt carried eight hundred and twenty impact marks and lay over fifteen degrees. For the landing phase the Chinese committed an reinforced battalion of more than five hundred men, each militia platoon numbering about forty, against a garrison of thirty-odd on Coral Island and a single platoon on Cam Tuyet; on 20 January forty-eight Vietnamese servicemen were taken prisoner.
cause: 起因是一場漁業與主權糾纏起來的邊界對抗。一九七三年一月關於越南問題的巴黎和平協約簽定，美軍開始撤出越南並把剩餘軍艦移交南越，南越海軍元氣恢復；同年八月起，南越軍艦便在西沙海域驅趕抓捕中國漁民。一九七四年初南越政府宣布要在西沙海域勘探石油。十二月底，廣東省水產廳南海水產公司派出南漁 402、407 兩船共九十七人赴永樂群島羚羊礁一帶捕撈，並在琛航島架設加工廠與通信電台；一月十日張秉林率漁民登甘泉島升掛國旗，豎起木牌。十一月外交部表態維權，十四日南海艦隊下令第七十七次巡邏，十五日 HQ-16 進永樂群島與漁船對峙、砲擊島上國旗，並放小艇載武裝海軍陸戰隊員與海關人員登船臨檢，漁民反抗後小艇折返。十六日中央軍委決定由廣州軍區統一指揮並在榆林基地設作戰指揮班子，越方則在十七日由 HQ-16 派陸戰隊占領金銀島、HQ-4 派二十七人登甘泉島取下五星紅旗插上南越國旗，十八日二十一時阮文俢復電旗艦，部署登陸琛航島並授權還擊，衝突至此再也收拾不住。
causeEn: The cause was a border confrontation that began as fishing and turned into a contest over sovereignty. In January 1973 the Paris Peace Accords on Vietnam were signed, the Americans began to leave and handed over their remaining warships to South Vietnam, and the South Vietnamese navy recovered its strength; from August 1973 its ships began driving off and seizing Chinese fishermen in the Paracel waters. Early in 1974 the Saigon government announced that it would explore for oil in the Paracels. At the end of December the South China Fisheries Company under the Guangdong Provincial Department of Fisheries dispatched the fishing vessels Nanyu 402 and 407 with ninety-seven men in all to work off Lingyang Reef in the Amphitrite group, setting up a processing shed and a radio station on Chenhang Island; on 10 January Zhang Binglin led fishermen ashore on Cam Tuyet Island to raise the national flag and set up a wooden sign. The Foreign Ministry stated China's position on 11 January; on the 14th the South Sea Fleet ordered the seventy-seventh patrol; and on the 15th HQ-16 entered the Amphitrite group, confronted the fishing boats, shelled the flag on the island, and sent a boat carrying armed marines and a customs officer to board and inspect the Nanyu 402, the boat turning back when the fishermen resisted. On 16 January the Central Military Commission decided that Guangzhou Military Region would command and that a battle command group would be set up at Yulin base. The Vietnamese moved in reply: on the 17th HQ-16 landed marines on Money Island and HQ-4 put twenty-seven men ashore on Cam Tuyet, pulling down the red flag of the People's Republic and raising the flag of South Vietnam; at 21:00 on 18 January President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu cabled the flagship ordering the landing on Chenhang Island and authorising return fire, and from that point the clash could no longer be contained.
impact: 海戰之後，中華人民共和國取得對整個西沙群島及周邊海域的控制權，一九七四年下半年解放軍守備分隊進駐中建島，十月一日西沙前指撤銷、守備任務移交海軍西沙水警區，一九七五年一月守備第一百五十團守島分隊撤離歸建。對越方而言，南越在黃沙群島的實際控制與主權宣稱，後來成為北越統一越南後向國際社會提出領土要求的主要依據之一，衝突的陰影一直延到一九八八年的南沙赤瓜礁交火與二〇一二年三沙市的設立。外交層面上，美國自一九七四年一月二十一日起明確不介入：一月二十一日國務院發言人約翰·金表示不支持任何一方，基辛格同日重申並對使用武力表示遺憾，一月二十三日美中在華盛頓會談，一月二十五日美方決策層議定不介入西沙與南沙事務；南越則向聯合國安理會提出抗議，黃華代表中國指西沙是中國無可爭議的神聖領土，安理會主席賽高里達建議提交國際法院。俘虜方面，一月三十一日與二月二十七日分批在深圳經紅十字會渠道遣返。此外，這是解放軍海軍第一次在白天、遠海、深水與外國海軍交戰；一月二十二日東海艦隊增援編隊通過台灣海峽，是人民海軍水面艦艇首次通過台海。三亞紅沙的西沙海戰烈士陵園於一九七五年建成，紀念碑由南海艦隊署名。
impactEn: After the fighting the People's Republic of China gained control of the whole Paracel group and the surrounding waters. In the second half of 1974 PLA garrison detachments took over Zhongjian Island; on 1 October the Xisha forward command was stood down and the garrison task passed to the navy's Xisha coast guard district; and in January 1975 the island detachment of the 150th Garrison Regiment withdrew to its parent unit. For the Vietnamese side, the actual control and the sovereignty claims over the Hoang Sa group that South Vietnam had asserted later became one of the main bases for the territorial claims made by the unified state of North Vietnam, and the shadow of the clash reached as far as the 1988 confrontation at Chigua Reef in the Spratlys and the establishment of the Sansha city in 2012. At the diplomatic level the United States ruled itself out from the outset: on 21 January 1974 State Department spokesman John King said the United States supported neither side, and Henry Kissinger repeated this the same day while regretting the use of force; the Sino-American talks in Washington followed on 23 January, and on 25 January the American decision-makers agreed that the United States should not involve itself in the Paracel and Spratly questions. South Vietnam lodged a complaint with the Security Council, where Huang Hua declared that the Paracels were China's indisputable sacred territory, while the Council president Sa Guidesa proposed referral to the International Court of Justice. The prisoners were repatriated in batches on 31 January and 27 February through the Red Cross at Shenzhen. The action was in addition the first time the PLA Navy fought a foreign navy in daylight, in open ocean and deep water; on 22 January an East Sea Fleet reinforcement group transited the Taiwan Strait, the first passage of surface ships of the People's Navy through that strait. The Xisha naval battle cemetery at Hongsha in Sanya was built in 1975, its monument inscribed by the South Sea Fleet.
result: 一月十九日上午十時二十三分越方先開火後，戰局在半小時內分出勝負：HQ-16 重傷傾側十五度、主機損壞，HQ-4 的雷達與七十六毫米砲被打壞，HQ-5 一百二十七毫米砲方向機受損而喪失射擊能力，HQ-10 艦橋中彈起火、艦長重傷陣亡；十一時許四艦陸續撤離戰場，十二時三十分 HQ-10 彈藥庫被命中爆炸，十四時五十二分沉於羚羊礁以南海域。十二時十二分抵達的 281、282 艇接戰殘敵，十九日黃昏前中方把傷員救上漁輪送回永興島救治。二十日，中方先以艦砲對甘泉島實施火力準備，九時三十分開火、九時五十五分四連乘橡皮舟衝灘，十時十分占領甘泉島並俘敵十四人；十時三十五分珊瑚島同樣受到火力準備，兩棲偵察隊與五連攻下三層砲樓，全島守軍三十五人悉數被俘，其中一人是美軍中校范文鴻；當日下午金銀島亦被攻占，俘敵四十八人。二十日夜南越「麒麟」號載一個營自峴港北上增援，走到半途擔心有去無回而折返。中方以陣亡十八人、受傷六十七人的代價，於二十日控制西沙全部島礁；越方陣亡七十五人、受傷十六人、被俘四十八人，損一艦傷三艦。二月十日榆林要塞區召開祝捷慶功大會，二月二十七日最後一批南越俘虜在深圳遣返。
resultEn: Once the Vietnamese opened fire at 10:23 on the morning of 19 January the battle was decided within half an hour. HQ-16 was badly hit, listed fifteen degrees and had a main engine damaged; the radar and 76 mm guns of HQ-4 were knocked out; the training gear of HQ-5's 127 mm gun was damaged and the ship lost its ability to fire; HQ-10's bridge was hit and set alight and her captain was mortally wounded. By about 11:00 the four ships had begun to leave the field, the magazine of HQ-10 was struck and blown up at 12:30, and she sank at 14:52 in the waters south of Lingyang Reef. The 281 and 282 boats, arriving at 12:12, finished off the crippled enemy, and before dusk the Chinese had the wounded lifted onto a fishing boat and sent back to Yongxing Island for treatment. On 20 January the Chinese laid naval gunfire on Cam Tuyet: the guns opened up at 09:30, the 4th Company went ashore in rubber boats at 09:55, and by 10:10 the island was held with fourteen prisoners taken. Coral Island received the same treatment at 10:35; the amphibious reconnaissance team and the 5th Company stormed the three-storey concrete gun position and all thirty-five defenders were taken, one of them a United States lieutenant colonel, Phạm Văn Hồng. Money Island was occupied that afternoon and forty-eight more prisoners were taken. On the night of 20 January the Vietnamese dispatch ship Kỳ Linh sailed north from Da Nang with a battalion of reinforcements but turned back halfway, afraid of sailing to a grave. The Chinese, at the cost of 18 dead and 67 wounded, controlled every islet of the Paracels by the end of 20 January; the Vietnamese lost 75 dead, 16 wounded and 48 captured, one ship sunk and three damaged. A victory ceremony was held at Yulin on 10 February, and the last group of Vietnamese prisoners was repatriated at Shenzhen on 27 February.
